what: a modelled two-start trapezoidal Tr40x14(P7) thread (ISO 2904, ISO 2903) on a d40 shaft, three leads long
method: groove volume per turn 2 pi int r w(r) dr over the material it cuts (Pappus on the axial section; a screw motion), w(r) = P - flat - depth (tan a + tan b); two grooves of lead 14 a half turn apart, so every meridian half-plane holds a groove section every pitch 7, as one groove of pitch 7 would: over 42 mm (three leads, six pitches) between free ends, so V = stock - 6 x that. Tolerance 0.01%: SMLib's exact screw sweep. ISO 2904 for P 7: 30 deg, H1 = P/2, crest flat 0.366 P, ac = 0.5 (P 6..12), external minor d3 = d - 2 (H1 + ac) = 32
